newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil is 8th-least risky emerging market - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil is 8th-least risky emerging market - paper.

text.p: Brazil is ranked the eighth least risky market among the world's 62 emerging nations, O Estado de S. Paulo newspaper said.
The paper said in story from Paris that a report by analyst Nord Sud Export revealed that Asia and Latin America are the most attractive emerging markets in terms of risk for investors.
Africa, the Middle East and Eastern Europe, whose risk ratings depend on factors such as peace processes, are considered "more delicate," the paper quoted the Nord Sud report as saying.

The report said the world's five least-risky emerging nations were all Asian - Singapure, Hong Kong, Taiwan, South Korea and Malaysia - followed by three Latin American markets: Chile, Mexico and Brazil, according to O Estado.
Brazil's three Mercosur sister nations, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay were 19th, 22nd and 37th respectively on the list while Guinea, Sudan, Zaire and Cuba brought up the rear, the paper said.
